views.label: Record, then notify
views.note: The decision is recorded with its reason codes, and the notice is generated from that record.

views.label: Contest with authority
views.note: A contest reaches a reviewer who sees the record and the person's representations and can change the outcome.

views.label: Outcome as evidence
views.note: The outcome and its reason go back to the person and into the decision record.

cards.title: One record behind every notice
items: The decision record holds model version, inputs, outcome and reason codes
The notice is rendered from it with a versioned template per regime
An eval checks the reasons are the factors the model used

cards.title: A contest that can change the outcome
items: The reviewer did not take the original decision
The reviewer sees the inputs, the reasons and the representations
A reviewer who confirms nearly everything is a signal, not a safeguard

cards.title: Recorded as evidence
items: Notice version, send time, contest and outcome sit in one record
Overturn rates by reason code feed the drift and fairness monitor
